app.title: MiSalud · Galaxy Watch
foot: MiSalud {version}. All data stays on this computer. A wrist watch does not replace a medical study.
welcome.title: There is no data yet
welcome.text: Export your data from Samsung Health (Settings, Download personal data) and choose the zip file. You will see a summary before anything is stored.
filter.label: Filters
kpi.label: Summary of the period
kpi.sustained: Nights with {min} min or more under 90 %
oxygen.low.title: Minutes under 90 % oxygen, night by night
oxygen.low.caption: Total time with SpO₂ under 90 % while asleep. The line marks 5 minutes. Use the mouse wheel to zoom.
oxygen.min.title: Lowest SpO₂ of each night
oxygen.min.caption: The lowest value of a single interval, of 1 or 10 minutes depending on the night. One isolated very low point can be a sensor artifact; read it together with the chart above.
oxygen.weekday.title: Nights with 5 min or more under 90 %, by day of the week
oxygen.weekday.caption: By the day you go to bed. The line is the average of the period.
oxygen.worst.title: The hardest nights
oxygen.calendar.title: Calendar of minutes under 90 %
oxygen.calendar.caption: One square per night, placed on the day you go to bed. Grey squares are nights without data. Click any day to annotate it.
oxygen.note: Oxygen figures use only nights with at least 3 hours of SpO₂ recording. A wrist watch does not replace a sleep study.
sleep.hours.title: Hours per night, monthly average
sleep.hours.caption: "In bed" is the session the watch detects; "asleep" leaves out the time awake.
sleep.score.title: Sleep score, monthly average
sleep.score.caption: Samsung's score, from 0 to 100.
sleep.stages.title: Sleep stages, minutes per night (monthly average)
sleep.stages.caption: Deep and REM are the stages that change most between months.
sleep.note: Months with fewer than 5 nights are not charted.
heart.hrv.title: Night HRV (RMSSD)
heart.hrv.caption: Each point is a night; the line is the median of the last 14 nights. Higher usually means better recovery.
heart.pulse.title: Pulse during the night
heart.pulse.caption: Average heart rate while you sleep, in beats per minute.
heart.hrv_weekday.title: HRV by day of the week
heart.hrv_weekday.caption: Median by the day you go to bed.
heart.pulse_weekday.title: Night pulse by day of the week
heart.pulse_weekday.caption: Average by the day you go to bed.
activity.steps.title: Steps per day, monthly average
activity.steps.caption: Daily total from the watch.
activity.steps.label: steps per day
activity.exercise.title: Recorded exercise, minutes per day
activity.exercise.caption: Only what you recorded with the watch counts; a workout you did not record does not appear.
activity.exercise.label: per day
activity.stress.title: Stress during the day, monthly average
activity.stress.caption: Scale from 0 to 100; the watch only measures while you are still.
activity.stress.label: average stress
activity.note: This view uses the period filter; the nights filter does not apply to days.
relate.title: Relate two metrics
relate.caption: Each point is a night. Pick two measures and see whether they move together. Measures that start with "Day" belong to the day the night began.
relate.note: A correlation does not prove that one thing causes the other. Nights without a value for either measure are left out.
relate.none: A correlation cannot be computed with {n} nights or with a measure that does not vary.
data.title: Data night by night
error.title: Something went wrong
import.title: Update data
import.choose: Choose the Samsung Health zip file.
import.step.comparing: Comparing with what is already stored…
import.older: This export is older than the last one imported: only missing records are added. {n} differing records stay as they are.
import.old_changes: {n} records older than 30 days changed. Samsung usually changes only recent data; worth a look before confirming.
import.compatibility: Samsung's format changed: {errors} tables cannot be imported and there are {warnings} notices.
import.nothing: There is nothing new to store. You can still confirm: the import is recorded.
import.backup: Before merging, the backup {name} was saved.
import.no_backup: First import: there was nothing to back up.
database.issues: What the validations found in the last import
database.no_backups: There are no backups yet. One is made before each merge.
database.restore_confirm: Replace the current database with this backup
night.title: Night of {date} · {day}
night.tags: Tags and note for this date
night.tags.caption: They hold for the day and for the night that begins that evening. One click sets or clears.
night.tracks.caption: Choose which tracks to see. Orange bands mark the intervals with oxygen under 90 %. Use the mouse wheel to zoom.
night.open_hint: Click a night, in a chart or a table, to see its detail.
tagcompare.title: Nights with and without a tag
tagcompare.caption: Compares the nights whose date carries the tag with the rest, inside the chosen period.
tagcompare.few: One group has fewer than 10 nights: the difference may be chance.
compare.title: Compare two nights
compare.caption: Each signal shows night A and night B below it, on the same axis. Bands mark oxygen under 90 % on each night.
compare.missing: There is no night recorded on {date}.
day.title: Annotate {date}
day.no_night: There is no night recorded on this date. The tags are saved all the same.
tags.title: Tags
tags.caption: Rename, switch off or add tags. Switching a tag off does not delete the dates already marked.
day.screen.title: Day {date} · {day}
day.tracks.caption: Pulse, stress, steps, recorded exercise and sleep on the same axis. Stress is measured only at rest, a few times a day.
hourly.pulse.title: Pulse on a typical day, by hour
hourly.stress.title: Stress on a typical day, by hour
hourly.caption: Average of each hour in the chosen period, with weekdays and weekends apart.
notice.short_window: {table}: Samsung exports this data only for {days} days. The database has it from {from} to {to}. Regular imports keep it.
report.title: Report for the doctor
report.contents: An A4 PDF. It always opens with the night oxygen summary, the night-by-night chart, the 10 nights with the most time under 90 %, the patterns and the method notes. The blocks you tick are added as annexes. It presents data; it holds no diagnosis and no recommendation.
report.personal: Include personal data in the header
report.name: Name
report.privacy: The PDF holds health data. It is saved where you choose and the app sends it nowhere; sharing it is your decision.
report.block.activity: Activity: steps, active minutes and pulse by hour
report.block.day_night: Day and night: the relation chosen in Relate ({y} by {x})
report.block.annotations: Annotations: nights with and without each tag
report.detail: Nights in detail (optional, up to two)
